split_audit.query_hash: sha256 of lowercase whitespace-normalized title and body
split_audit.feedback: only training rows passed to learning operators; held-out labels used for scoring only

methodology.execution: offline in-memory graph, no HydraDB queries; not live deployment evidence
methodology.parameters: unchanged defaults; no calibration or selection on this dataset
methodology.flat_fix_memory: same prior report embeddings and fix labels, no traversal or graph operators; unit FIXED_IN weights
methodology.learned_traversal_off: identical learned memory including learned FIXED_IN weights; structural and shortcut score terms disabled only for evaluation
limitations: Retrospective final source snapshot may contain later fixes.
Current issue bodies may contain later edits.
Mapped changed functions proxy fault location.
Cross-split query and commit overlap checked; semantic duplicates not detected.
Accuracy is strict: all changed functions must be in the first ten results.
MRR is truncated to ten candidates (MRR@10).
Issue-level bootstrap intervals are exploratory: reports can share a fix commit.
